name: Tell ReDream natural agency language benchmark v1
purpose: Guard the universal capture workflow against software-style phrasing requirements. Testers should speak naturally and should not need to know ReDream's schema.

cases.input: Spoke to Northbridge FC. They need a left-footed centre-back under 23, max €400k. Send Milan tomorrow. Jesse owns it.
Riverton United asked for a quick right winger, 20 or younger, loan only. Send Simon on Friday, I'll handle it.
Kota told me he wants to stay in Scandinavia next season and would prefer Denmark or Sweden. Call him next Tuesday to go through options.
Watched Lucas tonight. Left winger, really explosive one v one and gets in behind, but his final ball is inconsistent. Keep monitoring him.
Had a call with Eastport City. They like Simon but won't move before January. Follow up on 1 December.
Harbour Athletic said their budget is around €250k and they may need a striker in January, but nothing is confirmed yet.
Lakewood SK need a goalkeeper. Send Noah Monday. Alex owns it.
Quick one, thanks for the chat earlier. Nothing to do for now.
Spoke to Northbridge FC again. Their sporting director wants Milan's profile today and asked whether he is available on loan with an option. Send the profile this afternoon.
Simon told me he is not interested in Asia this window. He wants Europe only. No follow-up needed.
